issues.issue: Did Mr. Leuga receive procedural fairness at his PRRA hearing regarding his representation?
issues.applicant_position: Alleges procedural fairness breaches due to incompetent representation and hearing held while counsel was suspended.
issues.respondent_position: Not explicitly stated, but does not dispute facts about lack of notice of disbarment or email error.
issues.result_text: Court finds procedural fairness violated due to incompetent representation and hearing circumstances affecting fairness.
